system.rebuild_better_tra: Rebuilt better: transport +{amount}% from flood recovery.

events.heat_wave_answered: Heat wave in {region} answered: shelters open, lives held. {reward_note}
events.mega_fire_hit: Mega fire in {region}: absorption -{absorption}, funds -{money}, happiness -{happiness} (fire #{fires}){resilience_note}

events.mega_fire_opp: Rebuild better: restoration is half price while the ashes are warm.
events.flood_tsunami_opp: Rebuild better: transport will be rebuilt transformed next year.
events.energy_crunch_answered: Energy crunch defused in {region}: the grid holds. {reward_note}
events.social_crisis_opp: A window for change is open: the next sufficiency policy costs no happiness.
events.climate_summit_seized: Climate Summit seized: the coalition sets the agenda. {reward_note}
events.climate_summit_missed: The Climate Summit convenes without you.
events.green_investment_wave_missed: The green investment wave breaks elsewhere.
events.youth_movement_seized: The youth movement marches with you. {reward_note}
events.youth_movement_missed: The youth movement marches past your silence.

events.amazon_dieback_hit: Amazon dieback: the forest flips from sink to source. Absorption -3.0 Gt/yr.

endings.WIN_NEUTRAL: The balance holds. The world is carbon-neutral.
endings.LOSS_LIMIT_BREACHED: The limit for a safe human world is breached.
endings.LOSS_NOT_NEUTRAL: We survived the century. The job is not done.
